ai.heading: How AI Intelligence works
steps: Choose a taskAsk a general question, get cited answers from a PDF, extract structured fields, or create an executive summary.
Add a document when neededUpload a PDF for citations, extraction, and summaries. General chat can be used without a document.
Review the responseCheck cited pages and extracted values. Run OCR first when a scanned PDF has no searchable text.

apps.heading: How the apps waitlist works
apps.hero:
Native PDF Apps, Coming Soon

Use Paperplane’s browser-based PDF tools while native desktop and mobile apps are in development. No installers are available yet; join the waitlist for release updates.
steps: 01Choose a platformSelect the desktop or mobile platform you want updates about.
02Enter your emailProvide an address where Paperplane can send app availability updates.
03Join the waitlistSubmit the form to register interest. No app installer is available to download yet.
